# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.js from src/tools/. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run docs:tools`. -->

The MCP server exposes 89 tools: 41 read-only, 32 write and 16 destructive.

| Flag | Meaning | MCP annotations |
|---|---|---|
| read-only | Reads data only. | `readOnlyHint: true` |
| write | Creates or changes data, removes nothing. | `readOnlyHint: false`, `destructiveHint: false` |
| destructive | Can delete or overwrite data. | `destructiveHint: true` |

All tools validate their input strictly: unknown parameters are rejected, IDs must look like IDs
returned by other tools, dates are real `YYYY-MM-DD` calendar dates, and list sizes are capped.
Results come back as JSON text plus `structuredContent`; output longer than 40000 characters is
truncated with a hint to narrow the request. Failures are returned as `isError` results.
Parameters marked "yes" under Required must be given; the others are optional.

Write and destructive tools change the real account, including shared lists and meal plans.

## Meal plan

### `meal_plan_get`

**read-only**

Shows the meal plan for a date range, including planned calories per day and unscheduled meals. Default: today + 7 days.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | no | Start date as YYYY-MM-DD, default today |
| `days` | integer | no | Number of days, default 7 (min 1, max 60) |
| `to` | string | no | End date as YYYY-MM-DD, overrides days |

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `meal_plan_add`

**write**

Schedules a recipe as a meal. Without a date it goes into the unscheduled pool. mealTime: breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack or togo.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get (max length 200) |
| `date` | string | no | YYYY-MM-DD; omit for unscheduled |
| `mealTime` | `breakfast` \| `lunch` \| `dinner` \| `snack` \| `togo` | no | breakfast \| lunch \| dinner \| snack \| togo (default "dinner") |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"101abc","date":"2026-12-24","mealTime":"dinner"}
```

### `meal_plan_remove`

**destructive**, idempotent

Removes one or more meals from the meal plan (IDs from meal_plan_get).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mealIds` | string[] | yes | (min 1 items, max 100 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"mealIds":["abc123"]}
```

### `meal_plan_move`

**write**, idempotent

Moves a scheduled meal to a different date or slot.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mealId` | string | yes | (max length 200) |
| `date` | string | no | YYYY-MM-DD; omit for unscheduled |
| `mealTime` | `breakfast` \| `lunch` \| `dinner` \| `snack` \| `togo` | yes | breakfast \| lunch \| dinner \| snack \| togo |

Example arguments:

```json
{"mealId":"abc123","date":"2026-12-25","mealTime":"lunch"}
```

### `meal_plan_clear`

**destructive**, idempotent

Clears a date range of the meal plan. Without arguments: today + 7 days. With scope "unscheduled" the unscheduled pool is cleared instead - this affects all unscheduled meals at once and cannot be undone.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | `scheduled` \| `unscheduled` | no |  |
| `from` | string | no | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `days` | integer | no | (min 1, max 60) |
| `to` | string | no | Date as YYYY-MM-DD |

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `meal_plan_previously_planned`

**read-only**

Shows meals that have been on the plan before - a pool for a new week without having to search again. Returns recipe IDs for meal_plan_add.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | (min 1, max 100) |

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `meal_plan_note_add`

**write**

Adds a free-text note to a day of the meal plan. Returns the note with its id. Notes are listed under notes[] in meal_plan_get.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | string | yes | Day of the note, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `text` | string | yes | Note text, 1-2000 characters (max length 2000) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"date":"2027-01-15","text":"Guests at 7pm"}
```

### `meal_plan_note_update`

**write**, idempotent

Replaces date and text of an existing note. Both are always sent: pass the current date to keep the note on its day.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `noteId` | string | yes | Note ID from meal_plan_get (notes[].id) or from meal_plan_note_add (max length 200) |
| `date` | string | yes | Day of the note, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `text` | string | yes | Note text, 1-2000 characters (max length 2000) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"noteId":"01a0ffffffffffffffffffffffffffff","date":"2027-01-15","text":"Guests at 8pm"}
```

### `meal_plan_note_delete`

**destructive**, idempotent

Deletes a meal plan note. Can be undone with meal_plan_note_undelete as long as you keep the noteId (deleted notes no longer show up in meal_plan_get).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `noteId` | string | yes | Note ID from meal_plan_get (notes[].id) or from meal_plan_note_add (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"noteId":"01a0ffffffffffffffffffffffffffff"}
```

### `meal_plan_note_undelete`

**write**, idempotent

Restores a note deleted with meal_plan_note_delete (use the noteId you deleted).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `noteId` | string | yes | Note ID from meal_plan_get (notes[].id) or from meal_plan_note_add (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"noteId":"01a0ffffffffffffffffffffffffffff"}
```

### `meal_plan_meal_update`

**write**, idempotent

Updates the content entry of a planned meal. The API only supports two things: isLogged (mark the meal as eaten/logged, or undo that) and, for food entries (kind "food", not recipes), the amount. A recipe in a meal cannot be swapped or rescaled here - remove the meal and add a new one. contentId comes from meals[].contentId in meal_plan_get.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `contentId` | string | yes | meals[].contentId from meal_plan_get (max length 200) |
| `isLogged` | boolean | no | true = logged as eaten, false = not logged |
| `amount` | number | no | New amount, food entries only (> 0, max 100000) |
| `unit` | string | no | Measure unit name for the amount, e.g. "gram" (max length 50) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"contentId":"01a0ffff-ffff-7fff-bfff-ffffffffffff","isLogged":true}
```

### `meal_plan_settings_get`

**read-only**

Shows the settings of the meal plan: first day of the week and sharing mode (private or public) with the number of collaborators.

No parameters.

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `meal_plan_settings_update`

**write**, idempotent

Sets the first day of the week of the meal plan (the only meal plan setting the API has). weekStart: monday \| tuesday \| wednesday \| thursday \| friday \| saturday \| sunday.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `weekStart` | `monday` \| `tuesday` \| `wednesday` \| `thursday` \| `friday` \| `saturday` \| `sunday` | yes |  |

Example arguments:

```json
{"weekStart":"monday"}
```

### `meal_plan_share_link`

**write**, idempotent

Generates an invite link for the meal plan and returns it. Nothing is sent to anyone - passing the link on is up to you. medium: copy \| qr \| native_share \| email \| sms \| whatsapp \| telegram \| facebook \| twitter (default copy; qr returns a link meant for a QR code). Whoever opens the link can join the meal plan.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `medium` | `copy` \| `qr` \| `native_share` \| `email` \| `sms` \| `whatsapp` \| `telegram` \| `facebook` \| `twitter` | no | (default "copy") |

Example arguments:

```json
{"medium":"copy"}
```

## Weekly templates

### `meal_plan_templates`

**read-only**

Lists your own weekly templates. With templateId the meals per day are loaded as well (orderDay = offset from the start date, 0 = first day).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string | no | (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `meal_plan_save_template`

**write**

Saves a date range of the meal plan as a weekly template so it can be applied to any week later. Only recipes are copied; day offsets stay relative to the start date.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes | Template name (max length 300) |
| `from` | string | no | YYYY-MM-DD, default today |
| `days` | integer | no | Default 7 (min 1, max 31) |
| `to` | string | no | Date as YYYY-MM-DD |
| `description` | string | no | (max length 2000) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"title":"Week 1","from":"2026-12-21","days":7}
```

### `meal_plan_apply_template`

**destructive**

Applies a weekly template to the meal plan from a start date. Existing meals are kept; with replace the range is cleared first (existing meals in it are deleted). The template is validated before anything is cleared; if applying fails after the clear, the error lists the removed meals so they can be re-added. Returns the resulting plan.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string | yes | (max length 200) |
| `startDate` | string | no | YYYY-MM-DD, default today |
| `replace` | boolean | no | Clear the range first |
| `days` | integer | no | (min 1, max 31) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"templateId":"abc123","startDate":"2026-12-28"}
```

### `meal_plan_delete_template`

**destructive**, idempotent

Deletes your own weekly templates.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateIds` | string[] | yes | (min 1 items, max 100 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"templateIds":["abc123"]}
```

### `meal_plan_template_list`

**read-only**

Lists the curated public meal plan templates from Samsung Food (not your own - those are in meal_plan_templates). key "onboarding" groups them by diet, "wellness_tips" by wellness area (sleep, stress, ...). The template ids work with meal_plan_templates (templateId) to see the meals and with meal_plan_apply_template.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `onboarding` \| `wellness_tips` | no | (default "onboarding") |

Example arguments:

```json
{"key":"onboarding"}
```

### `meal_plan_template_update`

**write**, idempotent

Renames or re-describes one of your own templates (id from meal_plan_templates or meal_plan_save_template). Only the given fields change; the meals stay as they are.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string | yes | (max length 200) |
| `title` | string | no | New template name (max length 300) |
| `description` | string | no | New description (max length 2000) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"templateId":"01a0eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee","title":"Quick weeknights"}
```

## Shopping lists

### `shopping_list_get`

**read-only**

Shows the shopping list with open and completed items, grouped by category.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listId` | string | no | Default: primary list (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `shopping_list_add`

**write**

Adds free-text items to the shopping list, e.g. "2 onions". The server detects quantity, unit and category itself.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | string[] | yes | e.g. ["2 onions", "milk", "500 g flour"] (min 1 items, max 100 items) |
| `listId` | string | no | (max length 200) |
| `addToRecent` | boolean | no | Remember the items in "recent items" (default true) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"items":["2 onions","milk"]}
```

### `shopping_list_add_recipe`

**write**

Copies all ingredients of a recipe to the shopping list and merges quantities.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | (max length 200) |
| `servings` | number | no | Servings, scales the quantities (> 0, max 1000) |
| `listId` | string | no | (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"101abc","servings":4}
```

### `shopping_list_update`

**destructive**, idempotent

Checks items off, undoes that, or deletes them (IDs from shopping_list_get).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `itemIds` | string[] | yes | (min 1 items, max 100 items) |
| `action` | `check` \| `uncheck` \| `delete` | yes |  |
| `listId` | string | no | (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"itemIds":["abc123"],"action":"check"}
```

### `shopping_lists`

**read-only**

Lists all shopping lists of the account, including shared lists.

No parameters.

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `shopping_list_create`

**write**

Creates a new (non-primary) shopping list, optionally filled with free-text items like "2 onions". Returns the new list with its ID for the other shopping_list_* tools (listId argument).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | list name (max length 200) |
| `items` | string[] | no | e.g. ["2 onions", "milk"] (max 100 items) |
| `addToRecent` | boolean | no | Remember the items in "recent items" (default true) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"name":"Weekend BBQ","items":["2 onions","milk"]}
```

### `shopping_list_rename`

**write**, idempotent

Renames a shopping list.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listId` | string | yes | Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106) (max length 200) |
| `name` | string | yes | list name (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"listId":"10601aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","name":"Party"}
```

### `shopping_list_delete`

**destructive**, idempotent

Deletes a shopping list with all its items; this cannot be undone and affects everyone the list is shared with. The primary list is refused: call shopping_list_set_primary for another list first.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listId` | string | yes | Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106) (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"listId":"10601aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}
```

### `shopping_list_copy`

**write**

Copies a shopping list including its items into a new list (named "Copy of <name>", localized by the server). Returns the new list; rename it with shopping_list_rename.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listId` | string | yes | Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106) (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"listId":"10601aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}
```

### `shopping_list_set_primary`

**write**, idempotent

Makes a shopping list the primary one. The primary list is the default for shopping_list_get, shopping_list_add, shopping_list_add_recipe and shopping_list_update when no listId is given, so use with care. No-op if it already is primary.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listId` | string | yes | Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106) (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"listId":"10601aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}
```

### `shopping_list_recent_items`

**read-only**

Items recently used on any shopping list (the suggestion pool of the app). Returns {total, items}; if total exceeds the limit, raise limit (max 100).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 50, max 100 (min 1, max 100, default 50) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"limit":20}
```

### `shopping_list_favorites`

**read-only**

Favorite shopping items (quick-add pool). Returns {total, items} with the favorite IDs needed by shopping_list_favorites_modify; if total exceeds the limit, raise limit (max 100).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 50, max 100 (min 1, max 100, default 50) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"limit":20}
```

### `shopping_list_favorites_modify`

**destructive**

Creates, updates or deletes favorite shopping items in one call. ops is a list of {op:"create", name, brand?, comment?, quantity?, unit?}, {op:"update", id, name, ...} (replaces the whole favorite, so repeat the fields you want to keep) or {op:"delete", id}. IDs come from shopping_list_favorites. Returns the created/updated items and deleted IDs.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ops` | object[] | yes | (min 1 items, max 50 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"ops":[{"op":"create","name":"oat milk","quantity":1,"unit":"l"},{"op":"delete","id":"01a0dddddddddddddddddddddddddddd"}]}
```

### `shopping_list_share_link`

**write**, idempotent

Generates a share link for a shopping list and returns it. Nothing is sent to anyone; passing the link on is up to the user. accessMode in the result shows whether the list is private or public.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listId` | string | yes | Shopping list ID from shopping_lists (ids start with 106) (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"listId":"10601aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}
```

## Recipes

### `recipe_search`

**read-only**

Searches your own saved recipes across all collections. Side effect: the term is added to your recent searches (the account keeps the last 5). Restricted to one collection with collectionId. Note: does NOT search the global Samsung Food catalog - there is no API method for that; use recipe_discover to browse or fetch a recipe from a website via recipe_import_url.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Search term, e.g. "pumpkin soup" (max length 200) |
| `limit` | integer | no | (min 1, max 50) |
| `collectionId` | string | no | (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"query":"soup"}
```

### `recipe_discover`

**read-only**

Returns recipe suggestions from the global catalog for browsing. No search term possible - the API ignores it. Use seed to shuffle the selection.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | (min 1, max 50) |
| `seed` | integer | no | shuffles the selection, e.g. a random number (min 0, max 2147483647) |

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `recipe_get`

**read-only**

Fetches a recipe with ingredients, instructions and nutrition.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"101abc"}
```

### `recipe_similar`

**read-only**

Finds recipes similar to a given recipe.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | (max length 200) |
| `limit` | integer | no | (min 1, max 100) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"101abc"}
```

### `recipe_import_url`

**write**

Extracts a recipe from any website and saves it to the account. With dryRun it only parses, without saving.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes |  |
| `dryRun` | boolean | no |  |
| `collectionIds` | string[] | no | (max 50 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"url":"https://example.com/recipe","dryRun":true}
```

### `recipe_create`

**write**

Creates a custom recipe. With recipeId an existing recipe is overwritten.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | name (max length 300) |
| `ingredients` | string[] | yes | one ingredient per line, e.g. "400 g hokkaido pumpkin" (min 1 items, max 200 items) |
| `instructions` | string[] | no | (max 200 items) |
| `description` | string | no | (max length 2000) |
| `servings` | integer | no | (min 1, max 1000) |
| `cookTime` | integer | no | Minutes (min 0, max 100000) |
| `prepTime` | integer | no | Minutes (min 0, max 100000) |
| `images` | string[] | no | (max 10 items) |
| `collectionIds` | string[] | no | (max 50 items) |
| `recipeId` | string | no | (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"name":"Test soup","ingredients":["1 onion"],"instructions":["Cook."]}
```

### `recipe_delete`

**destructive**, idempotent

Deletes a custom recipe.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"101abc"}
```

### `recipe_update`

**write**, idempotent

Changes fields of one of YOUR OWN recipes (created with recipe_create or imported); everything not passed stays as it is. Passing ingredients or instructions replaces the whole list. Recipes of other users are rejected. The returned recipe.id is the one to use from now on (normally unchanged).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | ID of your own recipe, from recipe_search or recipe_create (max length 200) |
| `name` | string | no | name (max length 300) |
| `description` | string | no | (max length 2000) |
| `ingredients` | string[] | no | one ingredient per line, e.g. "400 g hokkaido pumpkin"; replaces the list (min 1 items, max 200 items) |
| `instructions` | string[] | no | replaces the steps (min 1 items, max 200 items) |
| `servings` | integer | no | (min 1, max 1000) |
| `cookTime` | integer | no | Minutes (min 0, max 100000) |
| `prepTime` | integer | no | Minutes (min 0, max 100000) |
| `images` | string[] | no | replaces the images (min 1 items, max 10 items) |
| `sourceName` | string | no | source name (max length 200) |
| `sourceUrl` | string | no |  |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"107abc","name":"Pumpkin soup","servings":4,"instructions":["Chop the pumpkin","Simmer for 20 minutes"]}
```

### `recipe_rate`

**write**, idempotent

Likes or dislikes a recipe (Samsung Food has a thumbs up/down, no stars). rating is exactly "like" or "dislike"; rating again replaces your previous rating. Only works for public recipes: private recipes (e.g. your own, never shared) are rejected with a moderation error. Returns the review including its ID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get (max length 200) |
| `rating` | `like` \| `dislike` | yes | like \| dislike |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"107abc","rating":"like"}
```

### `recipe_review_post`

**write**, idempotent

Posts your written review of a recipe with optional tags and a like/dislike. Tags are short lowercase words such as delicious, easy, fresh, go-to, spicy, moist, under-30-minutes, makes-leftovers. Public recipes only (private ones are rejected). At least one of text, tags or rating is required. Remove it again with recipe_review_delete.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get (max length 200) |
| `text` | string | no | Review text (max length 2000) |
| `tags` | string[] | no | (max 20 items) |
| `rating` | `like` \| `dislike` | no | like \| dislike |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"107abc","text":"They came out great","tags":["delicious","easy"],"rating":"like"}
```

### `recipe_review_get`

**read-only**

Shows a review. With recipeId: YOUR review of that recipe (null if you have none). With reviewId: that review (the id is in the result of recipe_rate / recipe_review_post). rating is like or dislike.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | no | Recipe ID from recipe_search; returns your own review of it (max length 200) |
| `reviewId` | string | no | Review ID from recipe_rate or recipe_review_post (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"107abc"}
```

### `recipe_review_delete`

**destructive**, idempotent

Deletes YOUR review/rating of a recipe (only your own can be deleted). Takes the recipe ID, not the review ID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"107abc"}
```

### `recipe_autocomplete`

**read-only**

Suggests search terms for a prefix, as the search box of the app does. With includeRecent your own recent searches are mixed in (flagged recent=true). Useful terms can be passed to recipe_search (own recipes) or recipe_import_url.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Prefix typed so far, e.g. "pum" (max length 100) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 10, max 50 (min 1, max 50, default 10) |
| `includeRecent` | boolean | no |  |

Example arguments:

```json
{"query":"pum","limit":5}
```

### `recipe_categories`

**read-only**

Lists the search categories of the explore page (id, title, image), e.g. chicken, pasta, vegan, under_30_min. type: "featured" = the home grid (default), "all" = the complete list. The titles work as search terms.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `featured` \| `all` | no | featured \| all, default featured |

Example arguments:

```json
{"type":"featured"}
```

### `recipe_smart_collection`

**read-only**

Smart collections are the automatic recipe lists of the app: made_it, recently_viewed, planned and my_recipes. Without collectionId it lists them (with recipe counts). With collectionId (one of those four ids) it returns the recipes in it, newest first by default, plus the available tags. Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for more.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | `made_it` \| `recently_viewed` \| `planned` \| `my_recipes` | no | made_it \| recently_viewed \| planned \| my_recipes; omit to list the collections |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100 (min 1, max 100, default 20) |
| `cursor` | string | no | nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page (max length 4000) |
| `order` | `newest` \| `oldest` | no | newest \| oldest, default newest |
| `tags` | string[] | no | tag names from a previous result, to filter (max 20 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"collectionId":"recently_viewed","limit":10}
```

### `recipe_recommended`

**read-only**

The personalized recommendation feed of the home screen, recipes only (id, name, image, who posted it). Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for the next page; seed shuffles the selection.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100 (min 1, max 100, default 20) |
| `cursor` | string | no | nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page (max length 4000) |
| `seed` | integer | no | shuffles the selection, e.g. a random number (min 1, max 2147483647) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"limit":10}
```

### `recipe_health_recommend`

**read-only**

Meal suggestions per day and meal slot that fit the calorie and nutrition goals of the account (see account_info), with the reasons (caloriesMacros, dqsAhei, foodList, mlRerank and their weight). mealTimes: any of breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack, togo (default breakfast, lunch, dinner). Recipe IDs can go to meal_plan_add or recipe_get. For more options for one slot use recipe_health_alternatives.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | no | First day as YYYY-MM-DD, default today |
| `to` | string | no | Last day as YYYY-MM-DD, default same as from |
| `mealTimes` | `breakfast` \| `lunch` \| `dinner` \| `snack` \| `togo`[] | no | breakfast \| lunch \| dinner \| snack \| togo, default breakfast, lunch, dinner (min 1 items, max 5 items) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 3, max 10 (min 1, max 10, default 3) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"from":"2026-11-02","mealTimes":["lunch","dinner"],"limit":2}
```

### `recipe_health_alternatives`

**read-only**

More health-based suggestions for ONE meal slot of one day (the "show other options" of the recommendations). mealTime: breakfast \| lunch \| dinner \| snack \| togo. Recipe IDs can go to meal_plan_add or recipe_get.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | string | yes | Day as YYYY-MM-DD |
| `mealTime` | `breakfast` \| `lunch` \| `dinner` \| `snack` \| `togo` | yes | breakfast \| lunch \| dinner \| snack \| togo |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 5, max 20 (min 1, max 20, default 5) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"date":"2026-11-02","mealTime":"dinner","limit":3}
```

### `recipe_dish_lookup`

**read-only**

Dish pages: generic dishes (burger, bread, ...) with typical nutrition per 100 g. Without urlPath it lists the top-level dishes with their urlPath (limit/cursor to page: nextCursor). With urlPath (as listed, e.g. "burger/cheeseburger") it returns that dish with the typical serving size in grams and the nutrition per 100 g.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `urlPath` | string | no | urlPath from the dish list (max length 200) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100 (min 1, max 100, default 20) |
| `cursor` | string | no | nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page (max length 4000) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"urlPath":"burger/cheeseburger"}
```

### `recipe_more_from_user`

**read-only**

Other recipes by the same author as a given recipe. The list is empty when the recipe has no user author (e.g. imported from a website).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recipeId` | string | yes | Recipe ID from recipe_search, recipe_discover or meal_plan_get (max length 200) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 10, max 50 (min 1, max 50, default 10) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"recipeId":"107abc","limit":5}
```

### `recipe_recent_queries`

**read-only**

Your recent recipe searches, newest first. Samsung Food only keeps the last 5, and every recipe_search registers its term there.

No parameters.

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `recipe_recent_query_delete`

**destructive**, idempotent

Removes one entry from your recent recipe searches (query = the exact text from recipe_recent_queries).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | query (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"query":"pumpkin soup"}
```

## Collections

### `collections_list`

**read-only**

Lists the recipe collections of the account.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | (min 1, max 100) |

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `collection_recipes`

**read-only**

Shows the recipes in a collection.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | string | yes | (max length 200) |
| `limit` | integer | no | (min 1, max 100) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"collectionId":"abc123"}
```

### `collection_get`

**read-only**

Details of one recipe collection: name, recipe count, accessMode (private \| public) and your role (owner \| none). Use collection_recipes to see the recipes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | string | yes | Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105) (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"collectionId":"10501cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"}
```

### `collection_create`

**write**

Creates an empty recipe collection. It is private unless accessMode is "public". Returns the new collection with its ID; fill it with collection_add_recipes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | collection name (max length 200) |
| `accessMode` | `private` \| `public` | no | "private" (only you) or "public" (anyone with the link can view) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"name":"Quick dinners","accessMode":"private"}
```

### `collection_update`

**write**, idempotent

Renames a collection and/or switches it between private and public. Give at least one of name, accessMode.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | string | yes | Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105) (max length 200) |
| `name` | string | no | collection name (max length 200) |
| `accessMode` | `private` \| `public` | no | "private" (only you) or "public" (anyone with the link can view) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"collectionId":"10501cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc","name":"Keto","accessMode":"private"}
```

### `collection_delete`

**destructive**, idempotent

Deletes a recipe collection. The recipes in it stay saved in the account, they only lose this membership. Cannot be undone.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | string | yes | Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105) (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"collectionId":"10501cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"}
```

### `collection_copy`

**write**

Copies a collection into a new one (the server names the copy). Returns the copy with its ID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | string | yes | Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105) (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"collectionId":"10501cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"}
```

### `collection_add_recipes`

**write**, idempotent

Adds recipes to a collection (a recipe can be in several collections). Recipe IDs from recipe_search, collection_recipes or recipe_create (ids start with 101 or 107). Only recipes already saved in your account work; others are reported under notSaved (save them first, e.g. with recipe_import_url or recipe_create). Returns {added, unchanged, notSaved, failed}.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | string | yes | Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105) (max length 200) |
| `recipeIds` | string[] | yes | (min 1 items, max 50 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"collectionId":"10501cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc","recipeIds":["10701eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee"]}
```

### `collection_remove_recipes`

**destructive**, idempotent

Removes recipes from a collection. The recipes themselves stay saved in your account (verified: even when this was their last collection, for recipes you created; for recipes you did not create, removing the last collection is refused). Recipe IDs from recipe_search, collection_recipes or recipe_create (ids start with 101 or 107). Returns {removed, unchanged, notSaved, failed}.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | string | yes | Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105) (max length 200) |
| `recipeIds` | string[] | yes | (min 1 items, max 50 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"collectionId":"10501cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc","recipeIds":["10701eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee"]}
```

### `collection_share_link`

**write**, idempotent

Generates a share link for a recipe collection and returns it. Nothing is sent to anyone. If accessMode in the result is "private", the link may not work for others until collection_update sets it to "public".

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | string | yes | Collection ID from collections_list (ids start with 105) (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"collectionId":"10501cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"}
```

## Pantry

### `pantry_get`

**read-only**

Shows the pantry with storage location, expiry date and daysLeft (negative = expired). Useful to see what needs to be used up before planning.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `includeConsumed` | boolean | no | Also include consumed entries, default false (there can be hundreds) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Page size, default 50, max 200 (min 1, max 200, default 50) |
| `offset` | integer | no | Entries to skip; use nextOffset from the previous page (min 0, default 0) |
| `search` | string | no | Only entries whose name contains this text (max length 100) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"limit":10}
```

### `pantry_add`

**write**

Adds entries to the pantry. IMPORTANT: for ingredients that can go in the fridge OR the freezer (meat, fish, butter), Samsung Food does NOT set an expiry date on its own - pass location here and the shelf life is computed from the food graph (chicken breast: fridge 2 days, freezer 9 months). Ask food_storage_info first if the storage location is unclear. Names that only approximately match a food-graph product (e.g. "oat milk" -> Milk) never get an automatic expiry date; those entries come back with matchedProduct and a warning.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `names` | string[] | yes | e.g. ["chicken breast", "basmati rice"] (min 1 items, max 100 items) |
| `location` | `fridge` \| `freezer` \| `pantry` | no | fridge \| freezer \| pantry - applies to all listed ingredients |

Example arguments:

```json
{"names":["chicken breast"],"location":"freezer"}
```

### `pantry_update`

**write**, idempotent

Changes the expiry date, name or storage location of a pantry entry.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | (max length 200) |
| `expiryDate` | string | no | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `name` | string | no | name (max length 300) |
| `location` | `fridge` \| `freezer` \| `pantry` | no | fridge \| freezer \| pantry |

Example arguments:

```json
{"id":"abc123","expiryDate":"2026-12-24"}
```

### `pantry_consume`

**destructive**, idempotent

Marks pantry entries as consumed, undoes that, or deletes them entirely.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `itemIds` | string[] | yes | (min 1 items, max 100 items) |
| `action` | `consume` \| `unconsume` \| `delete` | yes |  |

Example arguments:

```json
{"itemIds":["abc123"],"action":"consume"}
```

## Food and nutrition

### `food_storage_info`

**read-only**

Looks up where an ingredient is stored and how long it keeps there - without creating anything. Returns all possible storage locations with shelf life in days and whether the location is ambiguous. exact: false (with a warning) means the name was matched to the closest product, not found as such. Purely local, no API call.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | e.g. "chicken breast" (max length 300) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"name":"chicken breast"}
```

### `food_search`

**read-only**

Searches the food graph (generic foods and ingredients, not recipes). Returns food IDs for food_get and for meal plan entries. Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for more.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Search term, e.g. "banana" (max length 200) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100 (min 1, max 100, default 20) |
| `cursor` | string | no | nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page (max length 4000) |
| `language` | string | no | Two-letter language code, default: the configured locale |

Example arguments:

```json
{"query":"banana","limit":5}
```

### `food_get`

**read-only**

Shows one food: its portion sizes (name such as "medium"/"large", grams) and the nutrition per 100 g (Edamam codes like ENERC_KCAL, FAT, CHOCDF, PROCNT). Multiply by grams/100 for a portion. foodId from food_search.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `foodId` | string | yes | Food ID from food_search (max length 200) |
| `attributeId` | string | no | attributeId of the search hit, if it had one (max length 200) |
| `nutrition` | boolean | no | include nutrition per 100 g, default true |
| `language` | string | no | Two-letter language code, default: the configured locale |

Example arguments:

```json
{"foodId":"20271bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"}
```

### `food_autocomplete`

**read-only**

Suggests food names for a prefix (e.g. "ban" gives banana). The names work as input for food_search.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Prefix, e.g. "ban" (max length 100) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 10, max 50 (min 1, max 50, default 10) |
| `language` | string | no | Two-letter language code, default: the configured locale |

Example arguments:

```json
{"query":"ban","limit":5}
```

### `food_product_search`

**read-only**

Searches the Foodpedia product encyclopedia (ingredients incl. packaged products). Results are ordered by relevance (there is no sort option). Returns product IDs (upper-case canonical names) for food_product_get. Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for more.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Search term, e.g. "banana" (max length 200) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100 (min 1, max 100, default 20) |
| `cursor` | string | no | nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page (max length 4000) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"query":"banana","limit":5}
```

### `food_product_get`

**read-only**

Shows a Foodpedia product: category, description, storage location, glycemic index, nutrition per 100 g, grams per unit (piece, slice, ...), suitable diets, tips, substitutes and a few linked recipes. productId from food_product_search or food_product_popular.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `productId` | string | yes | Product ID (canonical name, upper case) from food_product_search or food_product_popular (max length 200) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"productId":"BANANA"}
```

### `food_product_popular`

**read-only**

Lists popular Foodpedia products (turmeric, ...). Use limit and the returned nextCursor (as cursor) for more.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results, default 20, max 100 (min 1, max 100, default 20) |
| `cursor` | string | no | nextCursor of the previous page, to get the next page (max length 4000) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"limit":10}
```

### `nutrition_analyze`

**read-only**

Parses free-text ingredient lines such as "2 cups milk" or "400 g hokkaido pumpkin" into the normalized food (canonical name), category, quantity and unit. Nothing is saved. To get the nutrition of a recognised food, look it up with food_product_get using the canonical name as productId.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | string[] | yes | one ingredient per entry, e.g. ["2 eggs", "1 cup milk"] (min 1 items, max 100 items) |
| `language` | string | no | Two-letter language code, default: the configured locale |

Example arguments:

```json
{"items":["400 g hokkaido pumpkin","2 eggs","1 cup milk"]}
```

### `foodlog_add_from_meal_plan`

**write**

Logs planned meals as eaten in the food log (so they count towards your nutrition tracking). mealIds come from meal_plan_get. Returns foodLogIds, which foodlog_delete needs to undo it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mealIds` | string[] | yes | Meal IDs from meal_plan_get (min 1 items, max 50 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"mealIds":["01a0aaaabbbbccccddddeeeeeeeeeeee"]}
```

### `foodlog_delete`

**destructive**, idempotent

Removes entries from the food log (the meal stays in the meal plan). foodLogIds as returned by foodlog_add_from_meal_plan; plain meal IDs from meal_plan_get are accepted as well.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `foodLogIds` | string[] | yes | (min 1 items, max 50 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"foodLogIds":["01a0aaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"]}
```

## Account and login

### `account_info`

**read-only**

Shows your own account with nutrition goals and settings.

No parameters.

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `auth_status`

**read-only**

Shows whether a Samsung Food login is stored, when it expires and when it was last renewed. Never returns the token itself.

No parameters.

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `auth_login`

**write**, idempotent

Logs in with a browser session: validates the value, renews it to learn the expiry and stores it. Log in at app.samsungfood.com, run copy(document.cookie) in the DevTools console and pass the result. The value is a session secret: it grants full access to the account.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | string | yes | Cookie string (document.cookie), bare token, "Bearer <token>" or a "Copy as cURL" command |

Example arguments:

```json
{"token":"fake-token-fake-token-fake-token"}
```

### `account_settings_get`

**read-only**

Shows the preferences of the account in a readable form: diets, avoidances, cuisines, cooking level, household, units, body data, nutrition goals, meal planning preferences and notification switches. account_info returns the raw account instead.

No parameters.

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `account_settings_update`

**write**, idempotent

Changes preferences of the account. Only the given fields change (field mask); list fields replace the whole list. This affects recommendations and nutrition goals of the real account - use account_settings_get first. nutritionGoals and emailNotifications are merged with the current values.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `diets` | `lacto-vegetarian` \| `ovo-vegetarian` \| `ovo-lacto-vegetarian` \| `pescatarian` \| `vegan` \| `vegetarian` \| `low-carb` \| `mediterranean` \| `ketogenic` \| `paleo` \| `dairy-free` \| `gluten-free`[] | no | Diets; allowed: lacto-vegetarian, ovo-vegetarian, ovo-lacto-vegetarian, pescatarian, vegan, vegetarian, low-carb, mediterranean, ketogenic, paleo, dairy-free, gluten-free. The list replaces the current one ([] clears it) (max 12 items) |
| `avoidances` | `alcohol` \| `caffeine` \| `celery` \| `crustacean` \| `egg` \| `fish` \| `gluten` \| `groundnut` \| `milk` \| `mollusc` \| `mustard` \| `sesame` \| `soybean` \| `sulphites` \| `tree-nut` \| `wheat` \| `lactose` \| `yeast`[] | no | Allergens/avoidances; allowed: alcohol, caffeine, celery, crustacean, egg, fish, gluten, groundnut, milk, mollusc, mustard, sesame, soybean, sulphites, tree-nut, wheat, lactose, yeast. The list replaces the current one ([] clears it) (max 18 items) |
| `nutritionPreferences` | `healthy` \| `high-protein` \| `low-sugars` \| `low-energy` \| `low-sodium` \| `low-fat` \| `high-fiber`[] | no | Nutrition preferences; allowed: healthy, high-protein, low-sugars, low-energy, low-sodium, low-fat, high-fiber. The list replaces the current one ([] clears it) (max 7 items) |

The list replaces the current one ([] clears it) (max 32 items) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"diets":["vegetarian"],"cookingLevel":"intermediate","nutritionGoals":{"calorieGoal":2000}}
```

### `account_usage`

**read-only**

Shows how many uses are left of a limited feature: mealplan_template_collections (curated meal plan templates) or hr_tailored_plan (tailored plan). Returns remaining and, when the quota is exhausted, when it is available again.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `feature` | `mealplan_template_collections` \| `hr_tailored_plan` | yes |  |

Example arguments:

```json
{"feature":"mealplan_template_collections"}
```

## Raw API access

### `api_methods`

**read-only**

Lists the available gRPC methods of the Samsung Food API, optionally filtered by substring. For everything that has no dedicated tool.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | string | no | e.g. "Community" or "MealPlan" |

Example arguments:

```json
{}
```

### `api_describe`

**read-only**

Shows the request and response fields of a gRPC method so that api_call can be used correctly.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | string | yes |  |
| `depth` | integer | no | (min 1, max 6) |

Example arguments:

```json
{"method":"whisk.x.list.v1.ListAPI/GetLists"}
```

### `api_call`

**destructive**

Calls any gRPC method directly. Use api_describe first to learn the field names. Write methods change real data. Login/session methods (AuthAPI) and account-credential methods (change e-mail, phone or password, delete the account, Samsung account code exchange) are refused. Secrets in results (tokens, auth codes, passwords) are replaced by "[redacted]".

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | string | yes | e.g. "whisk.x.list.v1.ListAPI/GetLists" |
| `request` | object | no |  |

Example arguments:

```json
{"method":"whisk.x.list.v1.ListAPI/GetLists","request":{}}
```
